name: Complete Set
description: Based on the theme of oriental lion awakening, six mini colored lions are created. The golden lion, the red lion, the orange lion, the white lion, the pink lion and the black lion each show their unique moves to help good luck UPUPUP. The six lion poses and six postures, such as coming out of the cave, picking green grass, playing with a ball, and going up to the stage, are a wonderful interpretation of the lion's spirit and spirit. Mini size, easy to hold in one hand, suitable for home display and combination. Simple entry, leisure and stress relief, and cultural inheritance through hand-made assembly.
